/api/swagger.json

API docs for Bazarr

Authorize

### BadgesGet badges count to update the UI (episodes and movies wanted subtitles, providers with issues, health issues and announcements.

### EpisodesList episodes metadata for specific series or episodes.

### Episodes BlacklistList, add or remove subtitles to or from episodes blacklist

### Episodes HistoryList episodes history events

### Episodes SubtitlesDownload, upload or delete episodes subtitles

### Episodes WantedList episodes wanted subtitles

### Files Browser for BazarrBrowse content of file system as seen by Bazarr

### Files Browser for RadarrBrowse content of file system as seen by Radarr

### Files Browser for SonarrBrowse content of file system as seen by Sonarr

### History StatisticsGet history statistics

### MoviesList movies metadata, update movie languages profile or run actions for specific movies.

### Movies BlacklistList, add or remove subtitles to or from movies blacklist

### Movies HistoryList movies history events

### Movies SubtitlesDownload, upload or delete movies subtitles

### Movies WantedList movies wanted subtitles

### ProvidersGet and reset providers status

### Providers EpisodesList and download episodes subtitles manually

### Providers MoviesList and download movies subtitles manually

### SeriesList series metadata, update series languages profile or run actions for specific series.

### SubtitlesApply mods/tools on external subtitles

### Subtitles InfoGuess season number, episode number or language from uploaded subtitles filename

### System AnnouncementsList announcements relative to Bazarr

### System BackupsList, create, restore or delete backups

### System HealthList health issues

### System LanguagesGet languages list

### System Languages ProfilesList languages profiles

### System LogsList log file entries or empty log file

### System PingUnauthenticated endpoint to check Bazarr availability

### System ReleasesList Bazarr releases from Github

### System SearchesSearch for series or movies by name

### System StatusList environment information and versions

### System TasksList or execute tasks

### System JobsList or delete jobs from the queue

### Webhooks PlexWebhooks endpoint that can be configured in Plex to trigger a subtitles search when playback start.

### Webhooks RadarrWebhooks to trigger subtitles search based on Radarr webhooks

### Webhooks SonarrWebhooks to trigger subtitles search based on Sonarr webhooks

### Plex AuthenticationPlex OAuth and server management
